label: Macarena (3D: a character dances on the card)

preset.title: ¡Hey, Macarena!
preset.intro: Lay the card flat, point your phone at it and keep it in view: someone is about to dance.
body: Somebody practised the Macarena in the kitchen all week, just to say this properly.
Arms out, palms up, a wiggle and a jump: happy birthday! May this year be loud, silly and full of dancing.

groups.title: The board
groups.note: The words on the board that comes up when the dance ends. Up to about 40 letters; longer words get smaller.
